results.name: Two affine maps with coincident fixed points and an underdetermined coordinate transform

linear_solution_family.nonzero_witness_method: Exact determinant polynomial; deterministic specialization over {0,1,...,n}.

results.verification: Every affine map equation and det(P) ≠ 0 were checked exactly.
results.interpretation: An invertible affine conjugacy was recovered from an underdetermined exact linear solution family. This is mathematical structural equivalence, not physical causation.

scope: Exact affine conjugacy of finite IFS map families in dimensions 1–3 over a common squarefree real quadratic field; map permutation search remains bounded.
global_guard: A verified affine conjugacy proves structural equivalence only; it does not prove common physical origin, energy transfer or causal coupling.
